data.description:
## Summary
Update `docs/main-street/core-rules-and-mechanics.md` §Action economy to document that `bankedActions` is consumed 1-per-action as the player acts, and verify/update HUD tooltip or i18n copy if it misstates consumption.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Core-rules doc updated:** `docs/main-street/core-rules-and-mechanics.md` §Action economy states that banked is consumed 1-per-action as the player acts (matching the corrected behavior).
2. **HUD tooltip verified:** `MainStreetHudTooltips.ts` tooltip text reviewed — update only if it implies banked survives spending (current text: "1 action per turn, with up to two turns' unused actions banked" — this is ambiguous and may need clarification).
3. **i18n strings verified:** Any localized strings reviewed for accuracy.

## Key Files

- `docs/main-street/core-rules-and-mechanics.md` — §Action economy: document 1-per-action banked consumption
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetHudTooltips.ts` — tooltip/i18n copy review and update if needed

## Dependencies

- Depends on: Implementation (CG-0MTECZMM00043UN6) — doc update should reflect the final implementation
data.title: Documentation: Update core-rules doc and HUD tooltip
